notes.title: Major Update 2
notes.content:
Added 2 announcer that help you in your journey, improved general balance of the game and revision of all Quests. New gameplay options to improve the quality of life and user interface now is now more clear.

Rewards in general were improved, weak weapons and skills improved and strong enemies nerfed.

General

- Added 2 different announcer voices for each type of vehicle: Pirate and AI announcer.
- Announcers events are: Low Energy, Invasion, Players Deaths, On item drop, 
Legendary Drop, On module destroyed, Out of ammo, Level up, Vote started, To get near the move module to move, 
Upgrade got, Players joining the game and Energy Shield depleted
- Remaked and improved all quests in the game.
- Quests may have a locked option, to unlock it, one or more players must have a specific skill, weapon or vehicle.
- All players now need to get near the move module to move the vehicle.
- Fast Mode removed.
- Players now auto target when firing the weapon.
- Added Epic and Legendaries consumables.
- Removed a useless module from the Standard Ship.
- Added and improved invader's drop.
- Complete remake of the User interface.
- Added volume option for the announcer.
- Added option to choose a specific announcer.
- Added another camera option: Vehicle Camera.
- Added gameplay option to not show decimal numbers.
- Added gameplay option to enable/disable the player Steam avatar.
- Added gameplay option to disable auto target.
- Tweaked calculation for the player EXP gain.
- Added new legendary weapon: Chain Laser Gun that chain a projectile to other invader.
- Added new type of sword: Greatsword, Heavy to swing.
- Added new legendary weapon: Great Greatsword, Heavy to swing.
- Added new consumable: Big Square Granade.
- Added 2 Legendaries cargos.

Balance

- Complete rebalance of Hard and Insane Mode.
- Increased the reward of delivering cargos.
- Increased reward from Supreme Drop Box and Uber Drop Box.
- Decreased the number of cargos dropped from enemies.
- Balanced prices of some upgrades.
- Balanced some overpowered enemies.
- Rebalanced all Final Bosses.
- Rebalanced multiple skills.
- Increased life of enemies that only invades.
- Increased Nature boat's energy boosts from 6 to 8.
- Nature boat's energy boosts now are bigger and easier to collect.
- Decreased cooldown of Nature boat's catapults and ballistas from 30 to 25.
- Increased Iron Rune repair from 6 to 10.
- Increased Overcharged Repair Tool energy from 5 to 50. (Now is harder to get)
- Tweaked the chance of invaders dropping nukes.
- Decreased Ray Gun range from 500 to 300.
- Decreased Ray gun explosion damage from 10x to 5x.
- Increased Ice Spear AoE from 250 to 275.
- Increased the power of some aura types.
- Increased the range of the majority of Auras.
- Increased the Ice Gun's damage of all rarities.
- Increased the Sniper's damage of all rarities.
- Decreased the reward after destroying a mini boss.
- Increased Healing Staff damage, range and healing area.

Sound and Visual FX

- Added combat music while any battle is happening.
- Added resource drop sound from invaders and reward chest.
- Added sound and FX for some upgrades and modules.
- Added tooltip for some upgrades.
- Added gameplay tips for some weapons.
- Improved shop's camera.
- Improved the overall visual of interfaces.
- Removed some feedbacks from the shop and added to the chat window.
- Improved Flamethrower VFX.
- Improved ray gun VFX.
- Added a icon for the reward chest.
- Added visual feedback for some skills.
- Improved end game screen.

Fixes

- Fixed multiple game breaking problems with enemies and invaders.
- Fixed de-sync with movement speed.
- Fixed lag in the skill tree.
- Fixed a problem causing some skills to not work as expected.
- Fixed a problem causing some auras to not work as expected.
- Fixed small issues with the gas mask.
- Fixed a problem causing two music playing at the same time.
- Fixed a problem causing some music to stop playing.
- Fixed some small tutorials issues.
- Fixed multiple matchmaking issues.
- Fixed Ice Spear AoE tooltip.
- Fixed Magic Staff dealing multiple damages.
- Fixed Falmechannter effect not playing correctly on the client.
- Fixed issues with weapon causing movement de-sync.
- Fixed Gold Tree giving too many resources.
- Fixed multiple issues with reward chest visuals.
- Fixed some controller icons on the interface.
- Fixed the repair tip at the mini map not been removed.

notes.title: Major Update out now!
notes.content:
We are releasing this version right now and coming back new year for more fixing!

- Added 20+ new items to the drop pool. Including a legendary version of those items
- Added 7+ new vehicle's upgrades. Some can be added to all vehicles types.
- Added a new random generated map system.
- Added Mini Bosses based on the type of the level.
- Added/reworked choices to all quests with new types of requirements.
- Added a chest inside the vehicles, making easy to find the reward loot.
- Added a reward system to ambush, mini bosses and at the end of the Ice Storm.
- Added a ice storm level event that modify all enemies and invaders.
- Added night levels with exclusive enemies and invaders.
- Added new UI elements for events and and player information.
- Added skill points to items base on type and rarity.
- Added 5 variations of final bosses. Mothership, Slime, Tower, Ice Slime and Nightmare Ship.
- Added new system for the Cargo's reward. They are random and get better with rarity.

Balance
- Adjusted resource gain from events.
- Added automatic balance based on number of players for invader life.
- Player damage won't change based on the number of players.
- Rebalanced of many skills.
- Rebalance all enemies and invaders.
- Rebalanced ambush and quest invaders.
- Rebalanced EXP gain, now players will also gain EXP from rewards.
- Rebalanced difficulties. It decrease the resource gain and increase the enemy's life.

Sound and Visual FX
- All maps where remade.
- Revised a lot of visual effects.
- Added a projection decal for improved readability of the weapon range.
- Added more sounds effects and better visual feedback in general. 
- Correction of many spelling errors.

Fixes
- Hundreds of bugs removed, some added.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/64b39e6d398699b3e7fd3fec4bddfc8d75b994f1.png


Gameplay
- Added Nature Boat vehicle, with 6 offensive weapons and trees that generate energy boosters. Player start with spark sword.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Village Boat
notes.content:
New Content
- Add new Vehicle: Village Boat
- Village Boat has 3 different weapons and all items are crafted from materials. 
- Added new version of the first vehicle: Kaos Spaceship
- Kaos Spaceship has a tesla weapon and generate items at the center of the vehicle. Generated items self-destroy when dropped.
- Add more enemies and invaders variations.
- Added option to change the mode while in the Lobby.
- Vehicle based on the Spaceship now have a fixed amount of Shield that is lost on take damage.
- Added more upgrades to the shop for every vehicle.
- Added new settings tab: Gameplay. The new tab has type of camera and option to not show the item name.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/28b3c207a779736dfa25ef2ad7adabd735a7220c.jpg

Gameplay
- Increased the time for the enemies' events to reset when all finish.
- Changed modules that don't close, to always be visually open.
- Decreased goo rain's goo size by around 30%.
- Increased invader drop change on death.
- Increased delay for the door to close in Ettar Spaceship.
- Changed position of Cleaner Gun in the Ettar Spaceship to make it easier to see.
- Changed position of all socket upgrades to make it easier to use them.
- Quests and Cargo now have a destiny that is guaranteed to have path.
- Added button to vote to leave the shop.
- Re-balanced all items, upgrades and skills values.
- Nerfed some enemies causing too much damage.
- Buffed invader only enemies to spawn more invaders.
- Burst Mode now drop a big number of items, give EXP at the start.
- Fast mode don't fix all modules when start moving, but revive all players.
- Buffed all start player's weapons.
- Balanced the use of energy of vehicles.
- Balanced some upgrades values to make some upgrades more or less desirable.

notes.title: Major Update: 1.2 [Skills, New Equipments and More!]
notes.content:
Players now gains skills points to upgrade their character during the game, 3 types of equips that are used during all game and a lot of improvements.

Skill Tree

- Added 3 different classes of skills: Support, Runner and Fighter. Skills can be upgraded by using multiple skill points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/5f7340638f55754d849d5fbfdeece00f7b95f547.png

- Players now have permanent equipment items that can only be drop by picking up another item of the same type.

- All weapons that spawn on modules were removed, now vehicles create ammo for the players over time.
- Equipment items (Weapon, Shield and Aura) are removed from the vehicle when it start to move.
- Equipment drop when destroying enemies, making Quests and on finishing Ambushes. Invaders don't drop weapons anymore.

notes.title: Added 15 Enemy Events, QoL and Balance - Patch Notes (23/Apr 2020)
notes.content:
Today we adding 15 news events that happen during the an enemy battle. Each enemy will have their own events making they more difficulty over time. Some quality of life were added to the game too, we added icons at the top of the interface to show how many modules are destroyed and how many invaders are inside of your vehicle and big changes were making on the balance of the enemies, mainly on enemies that only invade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/c8274b3a7c3fa58fb4b99295747386b0de8be9d7.png
Laser Overcharge inside the vehicle.

New Content
- Added 15 Enemies' Events! They happen during a Enemy battle, each enemy has it own events with diferent balance.
- Added Enemy Event: Full Burst. Create multiple explosions in X format after a delay.
- Added Enemy Event: Boss Invasion. Create the invader of the current enemy with extra life and damage.
- Added Enemy Event: Closing Destruction. Lasers close in until a small area of the vehicle, killing everyone on touch.
- Added Enemy Event: Goo Rain. Create a number of goo inside the vehicle.
- Added Enemy Event: Illusion Invasion. Create a big number of invaders with small life and damage for a limited amount of time.
- Added Enemy Event: Concetrate Lasers. Choose a random player and create multiple lasers that move to the player position.
- Added Enemy Event: Laser Saw. Rotating laser that move inside the vehicle.
- Added Enemy Event: Passing Laser. Multiple lasers that move one time side to side at same time.
- Added Enemy Event: Laser Overcharge. Create random lasers inside the vehicle that don't move.
- Added Enemy Event: Lasers Misaligned. Create 3 lasers that move in a path inside the vehicle.
- Added Enemy Event: Rotating Laser. Create multiple slow rotating lasers inside the vehicle.
- Added Enemy Event: Saboteur Invasion. Create one or more invader with high damage.
- Added Enemy Event: World Ends. Create a shield inside the vehicle and after some time kill all players that are not inside the shield.
- Added Enemy Event: Explosive Invasion. Create a invader that after some time explodes if not stopped.
- Added Enemy Event: Huntin Laser. Create 1 laser that follow a player around the vehicle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/da0be0a6dbbc4f95d1b7d7e6262e507091aceb3c.png

Select the game mode at the Create Game/Lobby window.

Game Modes
• Normal Mode
Don't change the game.

• Fast Mode 
It's normal mode but after a event move and repair all modules, no time to waste.

• Burst Mode
Very different mode where you start buying upgrades and fight powerful enemies and ambushes in succession with a mini Boss at the end. Always moving after events and enemies.

notes.title: New Vehicle and Big Balance Changes - Patch Notes (27/Feb 2020)
notes.content:
Today we are adding a variation of our current vehicle! The new vehicle has new mechanics that complete change how to play the game! More variations will come in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/4497db1d9e2496cc4e66d0b75ee9e23602a4417b.png

 New upgrades in the shop only for the new vehicle.

- Each new Energy Sphere has a different effect when destroyed. Red launch a projectile, White deal area damage and Blue give a speed buff.
- Added 3 new Upgrades and changed all upgrades to fit the new variation.
- Changed New Vehicle loader to Breech and to automatically shoot the projectile when it is inserted.

notes.title: Cargo Delivery and Goo System - Patch Notes (19/Feb 2020)
notes.content:
CARGO SYSTEM
Delivery the Cargo obtained from Quests and Enemies to get extra Resources, plan your route to get to the deliver level. Cargo can be attacked by enemies and when destroyed it cause a negative effect inside the Vehicle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/0f4e5a0b6021772535d3b9e5f3779597bc5f0bea.png
 Cargo drop from Enemies and Quests.
 Cargo will be assigned to be delivery in a level.
 To delivery a cargo in the level, just get to the Shop.
 Cargo give more Resource based on the distance and can give a Random Upgrade.

Cleaner Gun and Goo System
Remove Goo inside your vehicle with the new item added to the Vehicle. Goo can appear from the Vehicle taking damage and when Invaders are destroyed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/4fd24e050874df04a2fb469547687dd611edb6c6.png
 Added four different types of Goo. Bouncing, Slow, Slide and Radiation.
 Added module that have 1 Cleaner Gun and recharge it.
 Goo are permanent and can only be remove by the item.
 Goo stack the effect.
 Cleaner Gun remove the Goo faster with less player in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/39e4529ae98395530f5d262a48b8ce829ebdbb98.png
The new module with the Cleaner Gun

Changelog
- Added Cargo Delivery System. When you receive a cargo it give you a reward when getting in to the Shop of the Level.
- Added to Cargo drop from Quests and chance to drop from Enemies. Some quests show if the option give Cargo.
- Added the Cargo destination to show at the Mini Map.
- Added to Cargo life and will take damage by attacks and AoE effects like a module.
- Added to Cargo a Reward that increase based on the distance to deliver and some Cargos give a random upgrade.
- Added to Cargo a negative effect describe in the information when destroyed. The effect can be any negative effect in the game.
- Added to Cargo a detection that don't let it be stacked like items. They will find the nearest spot available.
- Added to Cargo only show information when picked.
- Added 18 Cargos variations.
- Changed 26 old quests to give Cargo. Options that give nothing now give Cargo.
- Added 5 new quests to show late in the game.
- Added Goo Effect. It's a permanent effect that stay inside the Vehicle until the player clean it.

- Added for the Fan Upgrade to remove all Goo inside the Vehicle.
- Added Slow Goo (white): It slow the player and can stack the effect. Gas Mask null the effect.
- Added Radiation Goo (green): It deal damage overtime. Gas Mask null the effect.
- Added Bouncing Goo (black): Make the player bounce up, making harder to turn when walking.
- Added Slide Goo (yellow): Punch player around, making harder to walk.
- Added Goo to drop from player's vehicle taking damage. Security ship drop slow Goo.

- Added a main shadow inside the vehicle.
- Fixed some modules not having name.
- Fixed possibility of invaders not find a position inside the vehicle
- Fixed invader sometimes not been able to get unstuck.
- Fixed item drop teleporting after moving to location.
- Fixed module button not showing the name.
- Fixed item positioning system.
- Fixed Mask not removing effects when picked.
- Fixed character leaving the game and not dropping items.

notes.content:
Local Co-Op Mode
Local Co-Op is here! We are adding today the ability for everyone to create a game to only play with Friend locally! Some changes were made to make the experience better and we are happy to improve the feature in the future!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/726a507d020a97f7cf41c161dc456be73917205c.png

The biggest change in the mode is the camera following everyone at same time. The camera change the distance and the angle to make everyone stay inside the action.

notes.title: What we're working on - Cargo Delivery and Fixed Unlocked Quest
notes.content:
Right now we are working to add to the game a Cargo Delivery System and fixed Unlocked Quest, that will show at the Mini Map. All those features will make Quests more mindful and give extra tasks to do. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/9c0810ee65c794c4ed76dd5fa3c59f6f4628576b.png
Each Cargo have a destination, a reward and may have a negative effect when destroyed


Cargo Delivery
 Cargo can me move around inside the vehicle.
 Each cargo have they own life and if destroyed can cause a negative effect.
 Players can get Cargo from quests and randomly from enemies.
 Players delivery Cargo at Quests or at the Shop of the destination level.
 Multiple Cargo from the same place will have the same destination.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/34e1def33669dbed63ce16e6132ee4410faaede8.png
You can see at the mini map what levels can receive the cargo.

Second Playable Vehicle
We are working in parallel in the second vehicle and we already have all the 4 Player's character ready to fight!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/5e2a80ba1a4efd74dbf43c0bdf6f79202b8b5377.png
Female version of the new playable character

TLDR: What we are working now:

 Second Playable Vehicle
 Cargo Delivery System
 Fixed Unlocked Quest
 Mini Map feedback
 Vehicle Security Ship variation
 Bug fixing

notes.title: Patch Notes (04/Feb 2020) - Mini Map Update and Fix
notes.content:
We are adding some extra information to the mini-map. You can see if the map has a fixed event of Burst Effect, Gas Effect or Ambush. Quests from levels that are harder give more reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/3e6d3052791f1988e47089e2237d96be5aab1b12.png
Changelog
- Added 2 new Enemies to the first Level. Gas Tower and Verkeer Leder K2
- Added visual feedback for each level fixed event to the Mini Map: Gas, Burst and Ambush.
- Removed ambush for some levels.
- Fixed shield showing negative numbers when already ended.


What we are working
- Second Playable Vehicle
- More quest variation.
- Cargo Delivery.
- Vehicle variation.

notes.title: Patch Notes (03/Feb 2020) - Added Mini Map!
notes.content:
Today we are adding a Mini Map to the game, the ALYD! This is a big feature that open a lot of possibilities for the future, for now this is everything you can see:

 Your actual position in the map.
 Possible levels you can travel to.
 Levels you already traveled.
 See all level's name hovering the mouse over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/ecc75760a2487d72c0cfcd837b1d55297dee745b.png

In the future we will add to the map the information:

 What different effect each level has. 
 Where the Quests or Rewards can be found.
 Special Events.

Changelog
- Added new Feature 'Map' to open during the game and to change level. Default buttons: 'C' and 'Dpad Up'.
- Map: Show actual level and possible levels that you can go, will be use in the future to show information in the map.
- Added feature when the Shop is closing to buy a random if more than one item was voted.
- Added small tip to the Tutorial to how to open the Map.
- Initial heal when entering the game don't show anymore.
- Increased change level vote from 15 to 25.
- Fixed some particles not following the vehicle.
- Fixed some Vote's image size.
- Fixed Drop box texture and size.
- Fixed client not attaching item's destroy effect to the vehicle.

notes.title: What we're working on - Vehicle #2 is on the way!
notes.content:
We are already working hard on more content for the game and next playable Vehicle is on the way. 

The vehicle is already playable and we only need to make the assets but we already did the player's character, the new crew for the vehicle are those cute Vikings! They will be using a Spear as they main weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/bff0ef550cef7aebcd301dd00eea4487353a0839.jpg
Player's character concept.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/d5ea9c24b3824cf9ad591473d3364f79cd2b1c84.png
Male character already done.

The new vehicle is VERY different from what we have now, no cards to open the modules and no Energy Sphere to use. This are the new Vehicle main characteristics:

 Mix of Medieval and Futuristic theme.
 New way to use the Vehicle.
 Player defend the Vehicle with melee weapons.
 Unique upgrades that change the Vehicle.


We don't have a date for when the new Vehicle will be out, but we will try to maintain everyone updated.

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 (Engine Update, Fixes and Balance)
notes.content:
Changelog
We made a big change by upgrading the Engine and we want to share all the changes that were made only this week. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348022/dfc48337cc75649d9ae415b2a84bad5c210f400e.png

Today
 Patch Notes (08/Jan 2020)
- Upgraded the Unreal Engine from 4.22.3 to 4.23.1. We are planning to upgrade to 4.24 in the future.
- Changed back the Enemy's laser damage multiplier again modules from 2 to 1.
- Decreased the Drone A1's Laser duration from 4 to 3 but increased the rate of fire from 12 to 10.
- Decreased the Drone A1's both Invader's life from 100 to 80.
- Improved the Particle effect when the module on fire deals damage to the Vehicle.
- Changed the camera shake to be based on the Vehicle actual life, increasing it when the vehicle is in a lower life.
- Fixed vehicle name not setting to the correct one.

This Week
 Patch Notes (07/Jan 2020)
- Fixed list server not showing the difficulty.
- Fixed players' life showing wrong.
- Fixed possible problem with player disconnecting while entering the game and character not been removed.

 Patch Notes (06/Jan 2020)
- Added more tips in the tutorial.
- Reduced the power of the first enemies in around 10%.
- Fixed some objects not showing.
- Fixed tutorial no showing correct tip.
- Fixed Main Menu animation not animating tutorial button.
